output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Load packages

```{r packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```

## Import cleaned data from Step 4

```{r import}
cars <- readRDS("../data/cars_step4.rds")

dim(cars)
```

Missingness Per column
```{r}

id_cols   <- c("id_trim", "Make", "Modle", "Generation", "Series", "Trim",
               "label", "pct_filled")
meta_cols <- c("Body_type", "car_class", "country_of_origin",
               "emission_standards", "Year_from", "Year_to")

col_audit <- cars %>%
  select(-any_of(id_cols)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ round(mean(is.na(.x)), 3))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "pct_missing") %>%
  mutate(type = sapply(cars[col], function(x) class(x)[1]),
         role = ifelse(col %in% meta_cols, "metadata", "feature")) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

print(col_audit, n = Inf)
```
